name: Kubernetes - Node
description: The Kubernetes - Nodes dashboard provides detailed information on the health and performance of the cluster nodes.
title: Kubernetes - Node

queries.queryString: cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_cpu_utilisation:avg1m   | quantize 1m |  eval _value * 100 | avg by node | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_cpu_saturation_load1:  | quantize 1m | eval _value*100| topk(500,max)
metric=node:node_memory_utilisation:ratio cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}}    | quantize 1m |  eval _value * 100 | avg by node | topk(500,max)
metric=container_network_receive_bytes_total cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}}   | quantize 1m | rate | sum by node | eval _value/1000000 | topk(500,max)
metric=container_network_transmit_bytes_total cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}}   | quantize 1m | rate | sum by node | eval _value/1000000 | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}} metric=node_load1 node={{node}} | quantize 1m| max
cluster={{cluster}} metric=node_load5  node={{node}} | quantize 1m| max
cluster={{cluster}} metric=node_load15 node={{node}} | quantize 1m| max
cluster={{cluster}}  node={{node}}  metric=node:node_cpu_utilisation:avg1m  |avg |  eval _value*100 | eval round(_value)
metric=node:node_memory_utilisation:ratio cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} | eval _value * 100 | avg | eval round(_value)
metric=node:node_memory_bytes_total:sum cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} | eval _value / 1000000 | sum | eval round(_value)
metric=node:node_num_cpu:sum cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} | quantize 1m using avg | sum
metric=node:node_net_utilisation:sum_irate cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} | sum
metric=node:node_net_saturation:sum_irate cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} | sum
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_net_utilisation:sum_irate | quantize 1m | sum by node | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_net_saturation:sum_irate | quantize 1m  | sum by node | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}}  metric=kube_node_info  | sum by kubelet_version, os_image, container_runtime_version, provider_id, kernel_version | topk(500,max)
metric=container_cpu_usage_seconds_total cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} pod=* | quantize 1m | rate | sum by pod, node | topk(10,max)
metric=container_memory_working_set_bytes cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} pod=* | eval _value / 1000000 | sum by pod,node | topk(10,max)
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node_namespace_pod:kube_pod_info: | sum by node | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_disk_utilisation:avg_irate | quantize 1m | avg by node | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_disk_saturation:avg_irate | quantize 1m | avg by node | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node_namespace_pod:kube_pod_info: | sum by node | sum
metric=kube_node_status_condition node={{node}} cluster={{cluster}} status="true" condition=ready | avg
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node_namespace_pod:kube_pod_info: | sum by node,pod

panels.title: Memory Limits vs Memory Requests vs Node Memory

queries.queryString: metric=kube_pod_container_resource_requests cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} resource=memory | quantize 2m | sum
metric=kube_node_status_capacity cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} resource=memory | quantize 2m | avg
metric=kube_pod_container_resource_limits cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} resource=memory | quantize 2m | sum

panels.title: CPU Limits vs CPU Requests vs Node CPU Capacity (Cores)

queries.queryString: metric=kube_pod_container_resource_requests cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} resource=cpu | quantize 2m | sum
metric=kube_node_status_capacity cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} resource=cpu | quantize 2m | avg
metric=kube_pod_container_resource_limits cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} resource=cpu | quantize 2m | sum
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=kube_node_status_allocatable resource=pods | sum
cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} metric=node:node_filesystem_usage: | eval _value * 100 | avg | eval round(_value)
metric=kube_node_status_condition node={{node}} cluster={{cluster}} status="true" condition="Ready" | sum by node,condition | filter latest > 0
metric=kube_node_status_condition node={{node}} cluster={{cluster}} status="true" !condition="Ready" | sum by node,condition | filter latest > 0

*events* cluster={{cluster}}
| json  "object.involvedObject.name" as name
| json field=_raw "object.involvedObject.kind" as kind
| where name matches "{{node}}" and kind matches "Node"
| count by name, _messageTime
| fields - _count
| timeslice 1d| count by _timeslice

cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} (error or critical)
| json  "log" as msg
| where !isNull(msg)
| count by node,pod,msg,_messageTime
| sort _messageTime desc
| limit 100
| fields - _messageTime, _count

cluster={{cluster}} node={{node}} pod=*
| json  "log" as msg
| where !isNull(msg)
| count by node,pod,msg,_messageTime
| sort _messageTime desc
| limit 100
| fields - _messageTime, _count

*kubelet*  {{node}}
| json "MESSAGE", "_HOSTNAME" as log, node
| count by node,log,_messageTime
| sort _messageTime desc
| limit 100
| fields - _messageTime, _count

*events* cluster={{cluster}}
| json  "object.metadata.namespace" as namespace
| json  "object.involvedObject.name" as name
| json  "object.lastTimestamp" as lastTimestamp
| json  "object.message" as message
| count by name, lastTimestamp, message, namespace
| sort by lastTimestamp desc
| fields - _count
| limit 100
